notes.text: The supplied heading ייסא is retained provisionally as Yeisa. The earlier audit label יוסא סבא is historical metadata, not a newly verified printed variant or identity determination. The abbreviated title remains R'.
Naso 144a follows קמד. under the period convention. Hyman does not identify an edition; earlier uncertainty is retained as a limitation on independent locator verification.
